title: Exporting One Session for Counting
description: Three commands that find a session, export it as JSON, and run a script to total its token counts.

steps.description: These commands work per message. `opencode session list` finds the session, and `opencode export` writes it as JSON for the script to total.
`opencode session list -n 5` lists the newest five sessions, with their IDs. You copy the ID of the one you want.
`opencode export ses_XXXXXXXX > session.json` writes the full session as JSON. Each assistant message in the export carries its own `tokens` block.
`python opencode_tokens.py session.json` runs the script that totals one export.
